description: Bionic Reading for LaTeX (.tex) files, with soft Morandi colours and adjustable depth and contrast.
config.enabled: Enable Bionic Reading decorations in .tex files.
config.palette.morandi: Classic: haze blue, sage, dusty rose, mauve, oat and grey teal in rotation
config.colorCycle: How the colour of the bold part rotates through the palette.
config.colorCycle.paragraph: New colour for each paragraph or section
config.depth: Colour depth. Higher levels darken colours on light themes and lighten them on dark themes.
config.fixationRatio: Fraction of each word (4 letters or more) shown as the bold fixation prefix.
config.minWordLength: Words shorter than this get no bold prefix.
config.fixationWeight: Font weight of the bold prefix (depends on your editor font).
config.restOpacity: Opacity of the non-bold part of each word. Lower values give more contrast.
config.colorizeRest: Tint the non-bold part of words with the palette's neutral text colour.
config.colorizeSyntax: Also tint LaTeX commands, non-prose arguments, math and comments.
